senses.definition_en: to accentuate (to pronounce with vocal stress)

examples.english: However, the reduction of unstressed vowels in this language is very notorious; many of them disappear completely in the mid-word as well as the word-final position.
examples.ref: 2015, Esther Herrera Zendejas, Tono, acentos y estructuras métricas en lenguas mexicanas., El Colegio de Mexico AC, →ISBN:
examples.text: Sin embargo, es muy notorio en esta lengua la reducción de vocales no acentuadas, muchas de las cuales desaparecen por completo, tanto en posición media como en posición final de palabra.
examples.translation: However, the reduction of unstressed vowels in this language is very notorious; many of them disappear completely in the mid-word as well as the word-final position.

glosses: to accentuate (to pronounce with vocal stress)

senses.definition_en: to accentuate (to mark with a written accent)

examples.ref: 2012, Pedro Manuel Jiménez de Urrea, Cancionero, Universidad de Zaragoza →ISBN Acentuamos la forma tónica del pronombre nós para distinguirla de la forma átona […]
examples.text: We accentuate the tonic form of the pronoun nós to distinguish it from the atonic form […]

glosses: to accentuate (to mark with a written accent)

senses.definition_en: to accentuate, to emphasize

examples.english: But even more important is that the unequal distribution of consumption in conditioned societies accentuates the importance of that symbol.

examples.text: Pero aún más importante es que la distribución desigual del consumo en las sociedades condicionadas acentúa la importancia de ese símbolo.
examples.translation: But even more important is that the unequal distribution of consumption in conditioned societies accentuates the importance of that symbol.

glosses: to accentuate, to emphasize
